observations: A cordless drill kit in an orange plastic carrying case.
The drill body features 'INGCO' and 'BRUSHLESS' branding (photo 0).
Two batteries are included, both labeled 'INGCO 20V MAX 2.0Ah' (photo 0).
A battery charger is present, labeled 'P20S' (photo 0).

The items are shown outdoors on a paved surface next to a red traffic cone.
